GIT_DIR.description: Optional standard Git directory override; conformance inspects its local promisor metadata before reading objects.

ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL.description: GitHub's runtime-provided OIDC request URL when the job grants id-token: write.

ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN.description: GitHub's runtime-provided OIDC request credential; read in process and never logged or persisted.

CI_OK_INTERVAL.description: Legacy cross-workflow polling interval in seconds; a low API budget raises the effective interval to at least 60 seconds.

CI_OK_SETTLE.description: Initial registration delay in seconds before the legacy cross-workflow gate starts polling.
